decisions.reason: This support service is tightly aligned with the firm's installed base, service and training capabilities, so its strong fit with existing knowledge makes continued retention likely.

The materials management module is close enough to the core practice-software workflow for the firm to improve it through its domain know-how and in-house development, though its lower prominence suggests somewhat higher withdrawal risk than the other additions.

Secure healthcare messaging fits the firm's regulatory, telematics and integration competences well, and the visible KIM update activity indicates the firm can absorb ongoing standards changes and keep commercializing the product.
